label: TP
reason: Both alerts (java/xss and java/tainted-format-string) are alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar, which is derived from user-provided param. The codeFlow shows that param is decoded and passed to doSomething(...), which modifies it but ultimately returns it as bar. Bar is then used directly in the format string and in the HTML response sink. There is no encoding or sanitization applied to bar before it reaches these sinks, making both vulnerabilities real.

evidence.note: User-provided value from Referer header is decoded and assigned to param.
Param is processed in doSomething(...) and returned as bar, which is used in the format string and HTML response.
